title: Clinic patient flow
summary: Reception sends patients to exam rooms or treatment rooms, and every visit needs one of two shared nurses. See why the rooms are not what patients wait for.
origin: Written for this project: a clinic with two kinds of room sharing a pool of nurses; answers from the branch split, utilization = arrival rate x mean service time / capacity, Erlang C and Little's law (docs/research/spec-4-template-sources.md).
